architecture.local_install_prompt: You are GitHub Copilot running in Agent mode in VS Code. Install and open the AI BAST Customer Loyalty and Rewards Agent from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/aibast-agents-library/main/solutions/customer-loyalty-rewards/deployment.json. Own the setup, verify the source path, confirm the expected tool in Brainstem health, run the smoke prompt, and open the local UI. Use synthetic data only, preserve every safety boundary, and do not publish or silently substitute another agent. Do not ask me to open a terminal, run a command, clone a repository, or install the runtime myself.
architecture.copilot_studio_prompt: You are GitHub Copilot running in Agent mode with the Microsoft Copilot Studio plugin. Prepare a draft Customer Loyalty and Rewards Agent from its deployment recipe. Ask only for the target environment and publisher prefix. Upload the packaged global instructions, two knowledge files, and one skill per operation; bind approved read-only connections; validate all locked prompts; and stop before publish with every external action and authorization gate visible. Stop before publish.
